translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: London’s plain declarative narration and his cumulative sentences are rendered in short, muscular Vietnamese sentences with concrete verbs; stiff Spanish-style or English calque syntax from the first draft was recast.
decisions.rationale: The book’s force is physical and unsentimental.

decisions.decision: The French-Canadian drivers and Hans speak in lightly marked colloquial Vietnamese; Perrault’s and François’s dialect is kept sparse.
decisions.rationale: Heavy dialect would pull attention from the dogs.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: ‘score’ (twenty) was misread in units 5 and 85; corrected.
The cause and effect of the Dolly chase were inverted; corrected.
‘giving the lie to’ rendered literally, and a causal ‘vì’ was added in unit 203; corrected.
‘unpacked earth’, ‘fathered’ and ‘it would burst him’ (units 304, 319, 310) were mistranslated or garbled; corrected.
‘stealing from their camps’ was rendered as slipping away; now ‘ăn trộm từ trại họ’.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.source_term: the law of club and fang
glossary.rationale: The book’s central formula, rendered identically at every occurrence.
Dogs are ‘nó’ and packs ‘chúng’, with no invented dialogue; the narration stays close to instinct without sentimentality.

glossary.source_term: Mush on / gee-pole / Salt Water / White River
glossary.draft_rendering: Tới đi / cần lái / Nước Mặn / sông White
glossary.rationale: Trail terms fixed once and used through chapters IV–VII.
Title words, kept as one phrase through the closing chapter.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #215, an electronic transcription of Jack London’s The Call of the Wild (New York: Macmillan, 1903). The Gutenberg page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated with the 1903 edition or with the earlier Saturday Evening Post serialisation (summer 1903).

unresolved_questions.explanation: A few interjections and the French-Canadian dialect are marked lightly or left in English.

title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title ‘Tiếng gọi nơi hoang dã’ is this edition’s own rendering; no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The song of the pack at the close.
